context: A police officer briefs on coordination
purpose: Teach: 炭素/載る/初年度/下見/即決/補っ/ルポ/用例

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 炭素関連の不正、近年、注視しています。
lines.en: We've been keeping a close eye on carbon-related fraud in recent years.
lines.style: Even, measured delivery. Professional baseline. Slight forward lean on 'close eye.' Steady eye contact. No urgency — this is known territory.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、警察と協力の旨、社報に載る予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We're planning to announce our cooperation with the police in the company newsletter.
lines.style: Formal but warm. Clear enunciation on 'cooperation.' Slight nod of agreement. Respectful but not stiff — showing readiness to align.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 初年度の合同訓練、効果ありましたね。
lines.en: The first-year joint drills showed real results.
lines.style: Quiet satisfaction. Slight approving nod on 'results.' Professional tone, but genuine — not performative. Pace steady, almost reflective.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。下見済みの避難ルート、再確認します。
lines.en: Yes. We'll go through the evacuation routes we've already surveyed and confirm them again.
lines.style: Practical, no-nonsense. Brisk pace. Clear emphasis on 'already surveyed' — showing due diligence. Respectful deference without hesitation.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 即決で動ける体制、整えてください。
lines.en: Make sure you've got a system in place to act quickly when decisions need to be made.
lines.style: Firmer directive. Light emphasis on 'quickly.' Not harsh, but authoritative — this is an instruction, not a suggestion. Steady gaze.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。隊員、必要なら補っていただけますか。
lines.en: Yes. Can we ask for additional officers if we need them?
lines.style: Respectful inquiry. Slight hesitation on 'if we need them' — not presuming, checking what's available. Polite but practical tone.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: はい。警察庁の方針、ルポ風に資料化しています。
lines.en: Yes. We've been putting together materials based on National Police Agency policy — written in a more narrative style.
lines.style: Informative, almost explanatory. Slight pride in the preparation. Measured pace. 'Narrative style' delivered with a touch of helpful clarification.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 用例、参考にさせていただきます。
lines.en: We'll use those examples as reference points.
lines.style: Closing tone — slightly abbreviated. Grateful, simple commitment. Not rushed but efficient. Subtle nod of acknowledgment.
